source_excerpt:

The No. 3 Georgia Bulldogs will face the No. 17 Florida Gators today for another edition of the SEC programs’ long-running rivalry series. But this meeting is different. For the first time, the Florida vs. Georgia football game will be held in the Bulldogs’ home state of Georgia , inside Mercedes-Benz Stadium in Atlanta. The rivalry series’ regular venue at EverBank Stadium in Jacksonville, Florida, where Florida and Georgia have played since 1933, is currently undergoing renovations.
At a Glance: How to Watch Florida vs. Georgia Game Online Free
Stream for free : DirecTV , Fubo , YouTube TV
Date, start time : Saturday, Oct. 31 at noon ET
Venue change aside, this weekend’s Florida vs. Georgia matchup is likely to be as exciting as always. The Dawgs are at 6-1 (4-1 SEC) this season, suffering their only loss at the hands of the unranked Auburn Tigers two weeks ago. Georgia has had some time to rest after a bye — and they’ll have quasi-home field advantage — but they could be less confident after that upset loss.
Florida (5-2, 3-2 SEC), on the other hand, will arrive in Georgia feeling hot after an upset win over the No. 11 Texas Longhorns. They’ll be in a similar position today, entering Mercedes-Benz Stadium as a 10.5-point underdog.
How to Watch Florida vs. Georgia: Date, Start Time, TV Channel
The Florida vs. Georgia game will take place on Saturday, Oct. 31. Kickoff is at noon ET/3 p.m. PT, and ABC will handle the national broadcast.
How to Stream Florida vs. Georgia Game Online for Free
Don’t have a cable box or satellite? You can still get a free Florida vs. Georgia livestream online. Below are four live TV streaming services that carry ABC and offer free trials that you can use to watch Florida vs. Georgia for free.
ABC is included in DirecTV’s MyNews and MySports Genre Packs and all of its larger Streaming Packages. All of these plans start with a five-day free trial . Pricing starts at $44.99 a month, but you’ll get a discount on your first month (after the trial).
Fubo carries ABC in all of its plans, and you get a five-day free trial to start. Once the trial ends, payment kicks in starting at $63.99 for the first month and $88.99 a month after that.
Another way to watch the Florida vs. Georgia game for free is with YouTube TV’s trial. The service carries ABC in both of its packages. These start at $71.99 a month after the trial, but you’ll get a discount for the first two to five months.
